---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(quartoWidgets)
library(sf)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1.  Load shapefile and prepare GeoJSON
#     geo_prepare() reads the .shp, simplifies geometry, reprojects to
#     WGS 84, and returns a GeoJSON string ready for embedding.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Absolute path — reliable when rendering inside a Databricks job
shp_path <- "/Workspace/Users/p.seinen@ggdhvb.nl/quarto-widgets/example_shapefile/wijk_shapefile_hvb.shp"

wijk_geo <- geo_prepare(
  path         = shp_path,
  name_col     = "statnaam",   # matched against the "wijk" filter column
  extra_cols   = "gemeente",   # kept so polygons can be filtered by gemeente
  simplify_tol = 150           # metres; reduce for finer detail
)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.  Synthetic indicator data
#     Uses the *actual* wijk names from the shapefile for three
#     demo-gemeenten so polygon clicks correlate with chart data.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
set.seed(42)

domains    <- c("Lichamelijke gezondheid", "Mentaal Welbevinden")
themes     <- list(
  "Lichamelijke gezondheid" = c("Beweging",  "Voeding"),
  "Mentaal Welbevinden"     = c("Gevoelens", "Hinder")
)
indicators <- list(
  Beweging  = c("Sport",   "Bewegen"),
  Voeding   = c("Groente", "Gewicht"),
  Gevoelens = c("Geluk",   "Stress"),
  Hinder    = c("Geluid",  "Overlast")
)

# Actual wijk/gemeente combinations (column names match shapefile properties)
wijken_tbl <- data.frame(
  gemeente = c(rep("Boxtel", 5), rep("Dongen", 2), rep("Gilze en Rijen", 4)),
  wijk     = c("Wijk 00 Boxtel", "Wijk 01 Lennisheuvel", "Wijk 02 Liempde",
               "Esch", "Verspr huizen Esch",
               "Dongen", "'s Gravenmoer",
               "Rijen", "Gilze", "Hulten", "Molenschot"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rows <- list()
for (wi in seq_len(nrow(wijken_tbl))) {
  for (domain in domains)
    for (theme in themes[[domain]])
      for (indicator in indicators[[theme]]) {
        key <- paste(domain, theme, indicator, sep = "|")
        rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
          gemeente  = wijken_tbl$gemeente[wi],
          wijk      = wijken_tbl$wijk[wi],
          domain    = domain, theme = theme,
          indicator = indicator, key = key,
          waarde    = sample(10:95, 1),
          gemeente_gemiddelde = NA_real_,
          totaal_gemiddelde   = NA_real_,
          stringsAsFactors    = FALSE
        )
      }
}
wijk_indicatoren <- do.call(rbind, rows)
wijk_indicatoren$gemeente_gemiddelde <- ave(
  wijk_indicatoren$waarde,
  paste(wijk_indicatoren$gemeente, wijk_indicatoren$key), FUN = mean)
wijk_indicatoren$totaal_gemiddelde <- ave(
  wijk_indicatoren$waarde,
  wijk_indicatoren$key, FUN = mean)

# Hierarchy tree
hierarchy <- list(
  name = "", key = "root",
  children = lapply(domains, function(domain)
    list(name = domain, key = domain,
      children = lapply(themes[[domain]], function(theme)
        list(name = theme, key = paste(domain, theme, sep = "|"),
          children = lapply(indicators[[theme]], function(ind)
            list(name = ind,
                 key  = paste(domain, theme, ind, sep = "|"),
                 value = 1L)))))))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3.  Initialise dashboard context
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ctx <- sunburst_init(
  data      = wijk_indicatoren,
  hierarchy = hierarchy,
  filters   = list(
    list(col = "gemeente", label = "Gemeente"),
    list(col = "wijk",     label = "Wijk")
  ),
  id = "hvb"
)
ctx   # inject CDN scripts + local bundle + data JSON + boot script
```

---

## Selectie

Kies eerst een gemeente, klik dan op een wijk op de kaart.

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="30%"}

**Gemeente**

```{r gemeente-selector}
# Standard TomSelect dropdown — filters which polygons are visible on the map
sunburst_selectors(ctx, filter = "gemeente")
```

:::

::: {.column width="70%"}

**Wijk (klik op de kaart)**

```{r polygon-selector}
# Polygon selector for wijken.
#   filter        = "wijk"       — this selector controls the "wijk" filter level
#   parent_filter = "gemeente"   — show only polygons whose gemeente property
#                                  matches the currently selected gemeente
#   geo_name_prop = "statnaam"   — the GeoJSON property that matches wijk column values
#   geo_parent_prop = "gemeente" — the GeoJSON property that matches gemeente values
sunburst_polygon_selector(
  ctx,
  geo             = wijk_geo,
  filter          = "wijk",
  parent_filter   = "gemeente",
  geo_name_prop   = "statnaam",
  geo_parent_prop = "gemeente"
)
```

:::

:::

## Analyse

```{r sunburst-row}
#| layout-ncol: 2
sunburst_chart(ctx)
sunburst_gauge(ctx)
```

```{r detail-panel}
sunburst_header(ctx)
sunburst_table(ctx)
sunburst_plot(ctx)
```
